The ''''aKraB clip-point vibrodagger''' was an 18cm long [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapon]] able to cut through [[Mark III Katarn-class commando armor|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] with relative ease. It was the favored close combat weapon of the [[New Republic Marine]]s, and was standard issue at the time of the [[Battle of Mindor]]; being more than a match for the [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|shadow stormtrooper's]] [[Vibroknuckler/Legends|vibroknucklers]].
